listing:
Basement studio — Victoria St N, Kitchener. Sublet Jan 1–Apr 30 2027.

Selling points:
• Self-contained studio, own entrance, own bathroom + kitchenette

• Lease is on the Ontario standard form; I'll give you a copy before you decide

Address: 318 Victoria St N, Kitchener. Come see it any evening after 6. Rent due on the 1st by bank transfer.

Thanks,
Dan (co-op in Calgary so can't extend)
label_rationale: Self-contained unit (no shared kitchen/bath), address given, evening viewing offered, rent plausible, written landlord consent (RTA s.97(1)), standard form lease copy offered before commitment (RTA s.12.1). Upstairs couple are tenants, not owners. No void clause or scam tactic. ADMIT.
